mechanics.name: Mirrored Illusion
mechanics.currentEffect: After you have repaired Generators for a total of 20% progression, press the Active Ability button while next to a Chest, Exit Gate, Generator, or Totem to create a Static Illusion of that prop. The illusion lasts for the tier duration. The perk deactivates after successfully creating an illusion.
activation: Be next to a Chest, Exit Gate, Generator, or Totem and press the Active Ability button.
Ends/deactivates when: Deactivates after successfully triggering the illusion.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (8.2.0): Reduced required Generator repair progression from 50% to 20% and reduced illusion duration from 100/110/120 to 40/50/60 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: After repairing 20% total generator progress, you can create a temporary static decoy beside a listed prop.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: No explicit once-per-Trial limit is stated; the perk deactivates after a successful trigger and requires its activation condition again to be available for another use.

editorial.summary: After enough Generator repair, create a temporary static decoy beside a Chest, Exit Gate, Generator, or Totem.
useCases: Place a distant decoy where the Killer might waste a quick glance or ranged action.
Mask the exact position of a real objective from far away.
Use creative prop placement for occasional mindgames.
counters: The illusion looks obviously artificial at close range.
Requires 20% repair before each activation cycle.
The Killer can ignore it without losing anything.
pros: Can be placed on several prop categories.
Long enough duration for a distant visual fake.
cons: Repair setup for a purely psychological effect.
analysis: Mirrored Illusion is a visual bluff rather than mechanical power. The decoy can occasionally make a Killer spend attention on the wrong object, particularly from long range or in a rushed rotation.
The problem is fidelity. The illusion is visibly holographic at close range, and experienced Killers have little reason to commit meaningful time to verifying it.
The perk also requires generator contribution before use, which means a productive action is being converted into an effect that may generate zero measurable delay.
That keeps Mirrored Illusion near the bottom. It can create memorable stories and clever clips without offering enough repeatable match value for a serious ranking.
editorial.verdict: Great theater, weak economics. Mirrored Illusion can fool attention for a moment, but rarely fools the Killer long enough to justify the slot.
